target: acceptance 4 — the class list lives in one named editable file, not scattered prose. Deleting a class from it must fail this case rather than quietly shrinking the sweep.
cmd: n=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/hardened.sh" classes 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); inj=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/hardened.sh" classes 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^injection$"); ssrf=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/hardened.sh" classes 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^ssrf$"); pi=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/hardened.sh" classes 2>/dev/null | grep -c "^prompt-injection$"); printf '{"n":%s,"injection":%s,"ssrf":%s,"promptInjection":%s}' "$n" "$inj" "$ssrf" "$pi"
